title: blinded hand-scan validation of high-amplitude large-lowering accepted/rejected two-pulse candidates

novel_ticket.title: P05h external reviewer calibration for borderline high-amplitude two-pulse hand-scan labels
novel_ticket.body: Repeat the P05g blinded hand-scan adjudication with two independent reviewers and a preregistered disagreement rubric for borderline high-amplitude/large-lowering broad-late candidates, then propagate reviewer variance into the P05f support frontier.
